comic-folk.voice: one adult rough baritone, narrow range
comic-folk.delivery: dry deadpan talk-singing, clipped punchlines, full voice
comic-folk.instruments: scratchy bowed fiddle answers, hand drum pulse
comic-folk.arrangement: short verses, group refrain, abrupt final punchline
comic-folk.production: dry small room, live unpolished ensemble
comic-folk.exclude: country twang, pedal steel, soft pop ballad, breathy crooning

work-song.voice: adult low solo caller and mixed adult group in unison
work-song.delivery: short projected calls, rough group answers, audible breaths
work-song.arrangement: one call answered each phrase, repeated refrain, stop together
work-song.production: natural room, voices at equal distance
work-song.exclude: instruments, children's choir, polished choir, lush harmony

solo-lament.voice: one adult low alto, chest register
solo-lament.delivery: plain sustained melody, controlled vibrato, clear consonants
solo-lament.arrangement: three stanzas, no big chorus, quiet resolved ending
solo-lament.production: close dry vocal, faint room air
solo-lament.exclude: instruments, backing choir, breathy pop voice, orchestral swell

electronic.voice: adult low spoken voice, short repeated hook
electronic.instruments: tight kick, sub bass, syncopated analog synth stabs
electronic.arrangement: eight-bar intro, hook, stripped break, final groove
electronic.production: clean low end, short room reverb, clear vocal
electronic.exclude: acoustic guitar, orchestral strings, arena EDM build
